pairs.registryProposal: The explainer cut holds each card for its line's measured take, falling back to the line's spoken length (lib/cut/explainer.ts:3-4). That is audio-first pacing applied to a generated-still film. The rule is wider than live-system capture, and it might belong in the voice or assembly subjects as a shared technique instead of living only under this subject.
